test_case.purpose: Verify the fully populated platform completes 100 true AC OFF→ON→BMC/OS-ready cycles at measured 40C/+5% rails without intermittent device loss, boot instability or unexpected errors.
required_package: Approved AC fixture/feed/inrush capacity and independent OOB
True-off/discharge/on dwell and BMC/OS readiness deadlines
Environment tolerances and per-cycle device/log oracle
test_case.test_command: Operator preserves baseline, verifies full population and calibrated environment, then uses the approved fixture for exactly 100 cycles. For each ledger row: remove AC, prove true-off/discharge for approved dwell, restore AC, prove BMC then OS readiness by deadlines, enumerate every expected device and record logs/health. Stop on any fault; after cycle100 restore nominal environment and reconcile inventory/evidence.
test_case.expected_result: All 100 ledger rows show complete OFF→ON→ready transitions, full expected inventory, no disallowed errors or instability, and successful nominal restoration.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires 100 complete independently evidenced cycles and no missing/intermittent device. Final boot only, fewer cycles, soft reboot, inadequate off dwell, log clearing or an automatic retry cannot pass.
safety_gate: Qualified high-power operator and approved fixture/feed/inrush capacity
OOB remains independent of switched feed
Abort on overcurrent/smoke/thermal fault, boot loop, deadline or device loss
Preserve logs, no retry, restore nominal
test_case.recovery: On any cycle fault, stop further cycling, keep AC in the approved safe state, preserve the failed ledger/evidence, use independent OOB and platform recovery, restore nominal environment, and do not retry the failed cycle automatically.
